strongest_angle: Analysis of October 2026 data from the Copernicus Climate Change Service and Australia's Bureau of Meteorology reveals that sea-surface temperatures in the central Pacific have reached unprecedented levels, hitting 29.70C in September and 30C by October 22, 2026.

key_facts.fact: According to the Copernicus Climate Change Service, sea-surface temperatures in a key Pacific monitoring region reached a record 29.70C in September 2026.
Central equatorial Pacific Ocean sea-surface temperatures touched an unprecedented 30C on October 22, 2026, marking the highest reading in modern observational history.
Australia's Bureau of Meteorology reported that the weekly relative Niño3.4 index reached a record +2.88 C for the week ending 25 October 2026.
